upstream_source: SCZ3 MAGMA gene-level pipeline (this study) on PGC SCZ3 European GWAS (Trubetskoy 2022, PMID:35396580, figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.19426775) merged with Open Targets Gentropy gPS (commit fec6427; uniqueDiseases column of disease_ta_index_pandas.csv, adopted verbatim).
extraction_protocol: MAGMA v1.10 snp-wise=mean, NCBI37.3 gene loc, 35 kb upstream / 10 kb downstream; merged onto ensembl_id, gPS = numDiseases per gene, tier_gps6 thresholds at {1, 2-5, >=6}. Region filters NOT applied in the file itself; consumers exclude chr X, MHC chr6:25-35 Mb, and 17q21 chr17:43.5-44.9 Mb at read time.

upstream_source: BIP2021 MAGMA gene-level pipeline (this study) on PGC BIP2021 European GWAS (Mullins 2021, PMID:34385711, figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.14102594) merged with Open Targets Gentropy gPS (commit fec6427; uniqueDiseases column of disease_ta_index_pandas.csv, adopted verbatim).
extraction_protocol: Same MAGMA protocol as SCZ3 (snp-wise=mean, NCBI37.3 gene loc, 35 kb/10 kb window). Adds `mhc` boolean flag (chr6:25-35 Mb).

upstream_source: SCHEMA Singh et al. 2022 (schema.broadinstitute.org snapshot 2026-05) restricted to FDR<0.1 PTV genes, cross-referenced with Open Targets 26.03 L2G + Ensembl VEP release 113 GRCh37 PAV consequence calls + this study's SCZ3 and BIP2021 MAGMA Z-scores + Open Targets Gentropy gPS (commit fec6427).
extraction_protocol: (1) Pull 34 SCHEMA FDR<0.1 PTV genes from SCHEMA API. (2) Annotate has_PAV via Ensembl VEP. (3) Merge magma_z_scz, magma_z_bip from gene_annotation tables. (4) Map gPS tiers from disease_ta_index_pandas. (5) Genes absent from MAGMA gene-property output flagged scz_source=='absent'. The Fig 4 script filters scz_source != 'absent' to render 29 plottable bubbles; the 5 absentees are listed in inputs/SCHEMA_absent_from_MAGMA.md.

upstream_source: MAGMA gene-property regressions for 9 traits x 2 models (Model A: gPS>=1 only; Model B: gPS=0 imputed), each via `magma --gene-results <trait>.genes.raw --gene-covar gene_property_log_gps_<nonzero|zeros>.txt --model direction=pos`. Source GWAS in inputs_manifest::upstream_source for each trait.
extraction_protocol: Each .gsa.out parsed to extract BETA, BETA_STD, SE, P (one-sided per direction=pos), and N_genes; concatenated as 18 rows (9 traits x 2 models). `n_eff` = effective sample size per trait. `power_caveat` flagged True for OCD2025 due to limited GWAS power.

upstream_source: Leave-one-out sensitivity re-run of the MAGMA gene-property regression for SCZ3 and BIP2021 across four LOO scenarios (original, noPsych_core, noPsych_OT, noPsychNoNerv), this study.
extraction_protocol: For each scenario, drop the listed disease IDs from the gPS numerator (see removed_disease_ledger.tsv), recompute log2(gPS+1) per gene, rerun `magma --gene-covar` with `direction=pos`. Reports beta_std, SE, p_onesided, attenuation_pct (vs original), and gps_variance_reduction_pct (% of original gPS variance lost).

upstream_source: Audit ledger of every disease term removed per LOO scenario in loo_gps_sensitivity_frontiers.tsv. One row per (scenario, disease_id) pair.
extraction_protocol: Disease IDs traversed from EFO_0000677 / MONDO_0002025 (psychiatric core) and EFO_0000618 (nervous-system) ontology branches. branch column records the ontology branch each removal anchors to. manual_classification kept blank for the resolved set.
used_by_scripts: 05_fig5_loo_sensitivity.py (audit only; not numerically used by the figure render)

upstream_source: Gene Pleiotropy Score table from Open Targets / Gentropy.
version_or_commit: Gentropy commit fec6427 (opentargets/Gentropy-manuscript, chapters/03-manuscript-figures/figure_1/disease_ta_index_pandas.csv; adopted verbatim, no transformation; MD5 03b7c1e7fc211cd69c6d00141bff20b0; accessed 2026-05-26; SWH request 2342637)
extraction_protocol: One row per Ensembl gene with uniqueDiseases (gPS = number of distinct disease associations) and uniqueTherapeuticAreas. Used by Fig 3 to merge gPS onto gene_annotation_table at read time.

upstream_source: Open Targets 26.03 L2G credible-set predictions joined to studyLocusId->diseaseIds across all GWAS studies.
version_or_commit: Open Targets release 26.03 (parquet -> CSV consolidation, this study)
extraction_protocol: geneId, score (L2G score), diseaseIds (list literal of EFO/MONDO ids), studyType=='gwas' only. Fig 3 filters to score>=0.5 then explodes diseaseIds for axis-membership tests.

upstream_source: gnomAD v4.1 constraint metrics (constraint_metrics.tsv), per-Ensembl LOEUF column.
extraction_protocol: Filtered from constraint_metrics.tsv to one Ensembl gene per row: MANE-select transcript preferred, canonical transcript as fallback; flag-filtered rows removed. Retained columns: ensembl_id, gene_symbol, transcript_id, loeuf, loeuf_lower, loeuf_rank, loeuf_decile, lof_oe, pli, lof_obs, lof_exp. 17,666 gene rows. Fig 2 consumes only ensembl_id and loeuf.
